# Expert elicitation process {#sec-elicitation}

We have cross-referencing tables from four experts, we identify the expert by their initials: JB, AL, AK, and MGT.

## First round

During the first round, the experts used different formats to represent the cross-referencing information. See Appendix @sec-input-memb for the steps to read the data in different input formats.

Data preparation is explained in @sec-data-prep, and visualisation of agreement and disagreement is in @sec-round-one.
